note: Small rustic campground on the east shore of Big Manistique Lake, ~4 mi N of Curtis on H-33; family-run since 1975. 5 Lakefront + 6 Northside lots (Northside easier for big rigs), 30-amp electric + central water; sewer/dump available. Shallow sandy beach, boat launch. Allows rigs to 50 ft. Nightly (~$30) and seasonal. No online booking; the official .com domain (biglakecurtis.com) is dead -- using the operator's WordPress page. --Claude
summary: The operator's only web page is a WordPress blog last posted in 2013: '15 sites with electricity at each site', 'right on Big Manistique Lake', in business since 1975 — no rates, season or booking information. Confirmed 15 sites; cleared directory-derived 30-amp, 50-ft max, potable water and dump. Google Maps: open, 4.6 / 31 reviews, phone 906-586-9551 matches, no website. Note trimmed only of the site count and 'by-phone reservations' (fields hold them).
flags: Stale website: https://biglakecurtis.wordpress.com/ has had no post since 2013 and posts no rates; biglakecurtis.com does not respond. Presence passes only via Google Maps (open, 4.6 / 31 reviews, phone 906-586-9551). No 2024+ operator rate and no booking engine: price rests only on RV Life $$. The note says nightly and seasonal sites; the seasonal share is unknown, and if it is long-stay in character it fails long-stay test 2 (no posted nightly rate). No gateway within 40 km (Pictured Rocks 73 km); the family has not stayed here.

Waterfront re-audit lead (contrary operator claim): 'We are located right on Big Manistique Lake ... We have beautiful shallow waterfront'; the entry is 'lakeview' (the note also names 5 Lakefront lots).
